identity_rule: The filename stem is the human-facing identity; directory layout does not imply scope.
body_rule: The Markdown body is guidance. No frontmatter means globally applicable guidance.

field_projection.routes: match an agent-selected current-work semantic applicability fact using explicit exact or /** subtree semantics
field_projection.read: surface a canonical repo-owned resource reference
field_projection.use: prefer an already admitted skill or capability

target_projection.typescript: generated TypeScript invokeJson client consumes the same CLI JSON operation and result kinds
target_projection.vendor_neutral: process CLI JSON with the operation and result kinds above

authority_rule: Instruction files cannot declare authority. Repo instruction admission and referenced capabilities retain their existing authority.
progressive_disclosure_rule: Metadata is inspected cheaply; irrelevant Markdown bodies and read targets do not enter the current operating contract.
migration_rule: Migration scaffolds and verifies an explicit human/agent-selected split; it never auto-classifies or overwrites arbitrary prose.
